name: Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd
summary: Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of antibody drugs. Its products include Enbrel, a recombinant human type II tumor necrosis factor receptor-antibody fusion protein for the treatment of autoimmune rheumatism and immunology; Jiannipa, a recombinant anti-CD25 humanized monoclonal antibody injection to prevent acute rejection caused by kidney transplantation; and Enbrel, an anti-IL-17A humanized monoclonal antibody ambroxol injection for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Shanghai, China.
